events.title: Gold Coast Eisteddfod GCE 2026 — GCE ORCHESTRA: C YRS 7-12
events.description: A competitive performance session featuring secondary school orchestras from across the region as part of the annual Gold Coast Eisteddfod. This event showcases orchestral talent and musical discipline from students in years 7-12.

events.title: Gold Coast Eisteddfod GCE 2026 — Bands & Orchestras session
events.description: A dedicated session for bands and orchestras participating in the Gold Coast Eisteddfod, providing a stage for local ensemble performances. Audiences can observe a variety of school and community musical groups competing and performing.

events.title: Gold Coast Eisteddfod GCE 2026 — GCE ORCHESTRA: YRS 1-6
events.description: A showcase of orchestral performances by primary school-aged students in years 1-6. This event is a staple of the Gold Coast Eisteddfod, highlighting young musical talent in a formal setting.

events.title: Gold Coast Eisteddfod GCE 2026 — GCE ORCHESTRA: YRS 1-6
events.description: A repeat session of orchestral performances for primary school students, providing further opportunities for young musicians to gain experience on the HOTA stage.

events.title: A&H Music, Movement and Magic: Nia for Kids
events.description: A creative, movement-based session for children that blends music and physical activity to encourage expressive play. Part of the Active & Healthy program to keep local kids engaged and moving.

events.title: Jazz & Gin (live jazz nights)
events.location: Garden Kitchen & Bar, The Star Gold Coast, Broadbeach
events.description: An evening of live jazz music hosted at the Garden Kitchen & Bar, creating a relaxed, atmospheric environment. Ideal for enjoying curated music alongside evening drinks.

events.title: Line Dancing on The Lawn (live music/entertainment)
events.location: The Lawn / Garden Kitchen & Bar, The Star Gold Coast, Broadbeach
events.description: A community-oriented social event featuring live music and guided line dancing on the lawn of The Star Gold Coast. A casual environment designed for people to participate, dance, and socialise.
